    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.superhero WHERE weight_kg = 0) AS zero_weights,

    (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) FROM main.superhero) AS min_weight,
    (SELECT group_concat(colour, ', ') FROM main.colour WHERE colour LIKE '%blue%' OR colour = 'No Colour') AS colour_labels
